# Define an argument for the CUDA version
ARG CUDA_VERSION=11.8

# Base image based on the CUDA version
FROM nvidia/cuda:${CUDA_VERSION}.0-cudnn8-runtime-ubuntu20.04

# Environment Setup
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV CONDA_DIR=/opt/conda
ENV PATH=${CONDA_DIR}/bin:${PATH}

# Install system dependencies and Conda
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ninja-build \
    wget bzip2 libgl1 \
    ca-certificates \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libsm6 \
    libxext6 \
    libxrender-dev \
    ffmpeg \
    nano tmux \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/l

# Copy the entire contents of the project into the Docker image
COPY . /app

# Install detectron2
WORKDIR /app/models
RUN python -m pip install -e detectron2
WORKDIR /app

# Initialize conda for the bash shell
RUN conda init bash
# Expose the port for Flask (adjust if needed)
EXPOSE 5000

## Installation:

**Prerequisites:**

- **Python >= 3.9**
- **PyTorch >= 1.8 with CUDA 11.x or 12.x support:**
  Follow the instructions on [official PyTorch website!](https://pytorch.org/)

**Steps:**

```bash
$ git clone https://github.com/shashekhar/aaiela.git
$ cd aaiela
$ pip install -r requirements.txt
$ # pip install --force-reinstall ctranslate2==3.24.0 # for cuda 11.8
$ cd models
$ python -m pip install -e detectron2
```

Follow [detectron2 install instruction](https://detectron2.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tutorials/install.html)

```bash
$ git clone https://github.com/shashekhar/aaiela.git
$ cd aaiela
$ docker build -t aaiela_conda --network=host --build-arg CUDA_VERSION=12.1 . # or 11.8

$ conda activate aaiela
$ python app.py # start a tmux session
```

FROM python:3.9
RUN (python -m pip install pytest pytest-xdist poetry || python3 -m pip install pytest pytest-xdist poetry || pip install pytest pytest-xdist poetry)
WORKDIR /app
COPY . /app

ENV PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
ENV PIP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=300
ENV PIP_RETRIES=5

RUN pip install -r /app/requirements.txt
RUN pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118
RUN cd /app/models && python -m pip install -e detectron2
RUN pip install pytest
RUN rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update && apt-get install -y libgl1 libglib2.0-0 libsm6 libxext6 libxrender-dev libgomp1 && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN pip install python-dotenv
RUN cat > /app/pytest.ini << 'EOF'
[pytest]
testpaths = tests
python_files = test_*.py
python_classes = Test*
python_functions = test_*
addopts = --ignore=models/detectron2 --ignore=models/detectron2/projects
pythonpath = .
EOF

The base64 string was truncated, resulting in malformed content being written to /app/pytest.ini. When the test command ran, pytest failed with 'unexpected line: (\t"' at line 9 of pytest.ini. The fix replaces the base64-encoded script approach with a direct heredoc that creates the correct pytest.ini with pythonpath = . configuration. This ensures the test module imports work correctly. Additional cleanup removes the JAYINT retry wrapper complexity and the duplicate verification scripts that aren't needed for the build recipe.
